name: Hockey stick identity
whenToUse: A sum of binomial coefficients with the same bottom number and increasing top number, which often comes out of casework on the largest element chosen.
pitfall: The sum must start at $\binom{r}{r}$. If it starts higher, subtract the missing beginning, which is itself a hockey stick sum.
derivation: Choose $r + 1$ numbers from $\{1, \ldots, n+1\}$ and do casework on the largest, $i + 1$. The other $r$ come from $\{1, \ldots, i\}$, in $\binom{i}{r}$ ways.
